summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima, an Argentine oil company, filed a Form 6-K reporting a material event: it entered an agreement to assign its interest in the Chachahuén cluster in Mendoza Province to Energía Mendocina S.A. and Compañía Andina de Petróleo y Gas S.A. The transaction, part of YPF's 4x4 Plan to optimize conventional assets and focus on unconventional fields, includes pipelines and warehouse stock. The price is US$200 million, effective June 1, 2026, with customary conditions precedent, plus applicable VAT and closing adjustments. Production from the cluster was ~10 thousand bbl/day oil and 0.03 million m³/day gas in Q2 2026. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing adjustments.
